name: fences-prose
description: Headings and prose between entries are ignored; a closed fence's contents are not entries; an unclosed fence is an error and blanks nothing.
notes: The closed fence hides a dec-shaped example AND a Status line. Parsing ignores the fence's contents, but the legacy scan still reports the Status line, which is the 2.2.0 behaviour this case pins (spec/FORMAT.md section 8). The unclosed file keeps both decisions: reporting and keeping is the safer pair, since blanking would silently drop every later rule.
